note: STATIC routing knowledge carried by catalog/modules.json but NOT derived from the filesystem: the ambiguous-term disambiguation table and the target module layout. Both name modules that may not exist yet, so R-DATA-01's filesystem validation applies to the generated `modules`/`files` arrays and never to these. Held here rather than as a Python literal in tests/_manifest_gen.py so the generator stays inside the 600-line tests/** ceiling it exists to enforce.
